lead: From opera at the Palau de les Arts to alternative theatre in Ruzafa. Valencia has a cultural agenda that never stops, with shows for every taste and budget.

Valencia’s cultural scene combines large international-standard venues with intimate alternative theatre rooms, street festivals and a concert offering that doesn’t rest any month of the year. The Palau de les Arts, the Teatro Olympia – with more than a century of history – and the Sala Russafa are some of the spaces that make Valencia a benchmark city for the Spanish performing arts.
Here you will find the city’s main theatres and performance venues, with their genres, approximate prices and where to buy tickets.

items.title: Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía
items.body: The great temple of Valencia’s performing arts, designed by Santiago Calatrava. With more than 40,000 m² and four halls of different capacities, it hosts opera, ballet, symphonic concerts, flamenco, contemporary dance and lieder. Its season runs from September to July with artists and companies of the highest international level.
facts: Large-scale productions with world-class conductors and voices
International companies and the “Friday Dance” series
Seasons with the Orquestra de la Comunitat Valenciana
Its own series of chamber music and varied performing arts
Av. del Professor López Piñero, 1 · City of Arts and Sciences
Season Sept–July · See the programme at lesarts.com

items.title: Palau de la Música de Valencia
items.body: The benchmark auditorium for classical music in Valencia, on the banks of the Turia Gardens. Home to the Orquesta de Valencia and to numerous seasons ranging from chamber music to grand choral concerts. Its programme includes the Chamber Series, the Symphonic Series and the Piano Series, among others.
facts: Grand concerts with the Orquesta de Valencia and guest orchestras
Chamber music with internationally renowned quartets and soloists
Recitals by the most outstanding pianists on the current scene
The Generalitat’s Children’s Choir and the great Christmas concert

items.title: Teatro Olympia
items.body: With more than 100 years of history, the Teatro Olympia is Valencia’s home of popular entertainment. Its wide programme combines big musicals in Spanish, classical and contemporary theatre, stand-up comedy and family shows. The stalls are accessible by ramps for users with reduced mobility.
facts: Mamma Mia, Tootsie, Sleeping Beauty and Broadway productions in Spanish
Repertory plays with top national companies
The best comedians on the Spanish scene live
Shows for all ages, especially at Christmas
Carrer de Sant Vicent Màrtir, 44 · Historic centre

items.title: Teatre Talia
items.body: The Teatre Talia is the Olympia’s sister venue, with a more diverse and experimental programme that spans theatre in Valencian and in Spanish, contemporary dance, flamenco and family shows. The “Abono Noches Talia+” series is one of the city’s most popular offers for theatre lovers.
facts: Own productions and co-productions with local companies
Panorama Flamenco series with the genre’s most outstanding artists
National and international contemporary dance companies
Shows suitable for the little ones at weekends

items.title: Sala Russafa
items.body: The benchmark venue for alternative theatre in Valencia, in the lively Ruzafa district. With an eclectic and daring programme, the Sala Russafa is the showcase for the city’s most contemporary and independent theatre, with small-scale shows, comedies, stand-up and innovative stage proposals.
facts: Local and national companies with cutting-edge proposals
Comedy in an intimate format with the best emerging comedians
Small and medium-scale productions with live music
Theatre research projects and experimental proposals
From €12 · Season tickets and discount passes available

items.title: Candlelight Concerts
items.body: Candlelit concerts in unique spaces in Valencia. Tributes to Queen, ABBA, Hans Zimmer and other artists at the Auditorio Mar Rojo and other singular venues.

items.title: Roig Arena
items.body: Liga Endesa games and European competition at the Pabellón Fuente de San Luis. One of the most decorated basketball teams in Spain, with millions of followers.

items.title: Concerts at La Marina
items.body: The La Marina de Valencia space hosts open-air concerts, festivals and music events of every genre all year round, in a setting by the sea.

items.title: Loco Club
items.body: Valencia’s most eclectic live music venue, in El Carmen district. Rock, jazz, electronic, indie and every kind of genre in an intimate format with a great atmosphere.

blocks.title: Tips for enjoying shows in Valencia
items: Buy tickets in advance — the most popular shows sell out weeks beforehand
The Palau de les Arts offers tickets from €6 for some shows in the “Vespres” series
The Teatro Olympia and the Talia have season tickets with significant discounts
The Sala Russafa has multi-ticket passes at a reduced price
The Palau de la Música offers discounts for young people under 30
Check the Visit Valencia agenda for free open-air shows
